items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I know Swayzee. ... That's all I can say. I can't even remember what he looked like, but I remember the name.

ctx.x: What about another trumpet player, Ed Swayzee? He's kind of early also.
Yeah, I know Swayzee. I'm trying to...
He was with Cab Calloway at one point.
